rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person's trustworthiness or whether others believe them.

example.english: I have always had credibility because I do what I say.
example.traditional: 我一向都好有信用，講得出做得到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 hoeng3 dou1 hou2 jau5 seon3 jung6 gong2 dak1 ceot1 zou6 dak1 dou3

rows.note: Use this for the credibility of a person, organization, or institution in the eyes of the public.

example.english: This charity is transparent and has a lot of credibility in the public’s eyes.
example.traditional: 呢間慈善機構做事透明，喺市民心目中好有公信力。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ci4 sin6 gei1 kau3 zou6 si6 tau3 ming4 hai2 si5 man4 sam1 muk6 zung1 hou2 jau5 gung1 seon3 lik6

rows.note: Use this when focusing on how believable a claim, explanation, or source is, or on its degree of credibility.

example.english: This piece of news has low credibility because it has no source.
example.traditional: 呢個消息冇來源，可信度唔高。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu1 sik1 mou5 loi4 jyun4 ho2 seon3 dou6 m4 gou1
